title: Synthetic diabetes evidence literacy case
content: SYNTHETIC EDUCATIONAL CASE: A fictional research team studies type 2 diabetes evidence retrieval. They record study population, publication date, and uncertainty before comparing findings. This invented passage contains no treatment recommendation.

title: Synthetic hypertension review workflow
content: SYNTHETIC EDUCATIONAL CASE: A fictional hypertension review compares blood pressure measurement methods across studies. Different populations and measurement protocols can limit comparability. Reviewers must inspect original evidence before drawing conclusions.

title: Synthetic evidence updating protocol
content: SYNTHETIC RESEARCH PROTOCOL: New evidence is compared with existing knowledge by publication date and passage overlap. Potential conflicts are flagged for human review. A later publication does not by itself establish stronger evidence. Prior versions are retained.
